#Mesh block level exploration

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| echo: false
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(qs)
library(sf)
library(rdeck)
library(reactable)
library(reactablefmtr)
library(sparkline)

trimmed_results <- qs::qread('../qs/trimmed_results.qs') %>%
  as.data.table() %>%
  setkey(mb_code21)

get_random_mb_for_testing <- function() {
  random_mb <- trimmed_results %>%
    slice_sample(n=1) %>% pull(mb_code21)
  cat(random_mb)
  #20457495000
}

mb_dt <- qs::qread('../qs/mb_dt.qs')
amenity_stats <- qs::qread('../qs/amenity_stats.qs')
#mb_dt <- qs::qread('qs/mb_dt.qs') %>%  setkey(MB_CODE21)

#trimmed_results <- qs::qread('qs/trimmed_results.qs') %>% as.data.table() %>% setkey(mb_code21)

map_accessible_mesh_blocks <- function(mesh_block_list) {
  
  mesh_shapefiles <- mb_dt[mesh_block_list] %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    st_set_geometry('geometry')
  
  rdeck(initial_bounds = st_bbox(mesh_shapefiles)) %>%
      add_polygon_layer(
        data = mesh_shapefiles,
        get_polygon = geometry,
        pickable = TRUE
      )
}

```

```{r}
#| context: server

session <- getDefaultReactiveDomain()

mb_code_reactive <- reactive({
  query <- parseQueryString(session$clientData$url_search)

  if (is.null(query$mb_code)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  result <- trimmed_results[as.character(query$mb_code)]

  if (nrow(result) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  result
})

```

textOutput("mb_message")

## reachable amenities
here are the reachable amenities
```{r}
reactableOutput("amenity_table")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$mb_message <- renderText({
  mesh_block_object <- mb_code_reactive()
  if (is.null(mesh_block_object)) {
    "No mesh block specified. Add ?mb_code=YOUR_CODE to the URL"
  } else {
    ""
  }
})

output$mb_map <- renderRdeck({
  mesh_block_object <- mb_code_reactive()
  
  accessible_mesh_blocks <- unlist(mesh_block_object$mesh_block_list[[1]])
  
  if (!is.null(accessible_mesh_blocks)) {
    map_accessible_mesh_blocks(accessible_mesh_blocks)
  }
})

output$amenity_table <- renderReactable({
  mesh_block_object <- mb_code_reactive()

  if (is.null(mesh_block_object)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  amenity_table <- copy(mesh_block_object)[, c("mesh_block_list", "mb_code21") := NULL]

  # Pivot to long format and join with stats
  table_data <- amenity_table %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "amenity", values_to = 'value') %>%
    left_join(amenity_stats, by = "amenity")

  reactable(
    table_data,
    columns = list(
      amenity = colDef(name = "Amenity", minWidth = 150),
      value = colDef(name = "This Mesh Block", width = 120),
      min = colDef(show = FALSE),
      q25 = colDef(show = FALSE),
      median = colDef(show = FALSE),
      q75 = colDef(show = FALSE),
      max = colDef(show = FALSE),
      distribution = colDef(
        name = "Melbourne Distribution",
        width = 200,
        cell = function(value, index) {
          row <- table_data[index, ]
          sparkline(c(row$min, row$q25, row$median, row$q75, row$max), type = "box")
        }
      )
    )
  )
})
```
